name: Aura Pro AI Phone
description: Aura Pro AI Phone is a premium AI smartphone featuring dedicated on-device neural processing, studio-grade computational photography, and multi-day intelligent power management at an accessible flagship price of ₹42,999.
target_group: Young creators, developers, and tech-forward students

features.name: Neural On-Device Co-Processor
features.explanation: Dedicated NPU handling live transcription, translation, and summaries completely offline.

features.name: Studio Portrait & Astro Engine
features.explanation: Computational photography pipeline with automated low-light noise reduction and dynamic focus.

features.name: Adaptive Intelligent Power
features.explanation: AI battery scheduler that reduces background power drain based on daily app routines.

features.name: Hardware Privacy Enclave
features.explanation: Isolated biometric and sensitive credential vault with physical sensor cut-off indicator.

features.name: ProMotion 144Hz OLED Display
features.explanation: Ultra-responsive HDR display engineered for intensive multitasking and creative editing.

features.name: Minimalist Intuitive OS
features.explanation: Bloatware-free user interface with distraction-free focus modes and voice shortcuts.
